external_evidence.reading: a claim of absence needs the external record to cover the whole slot; where it does not, the class is UNKNOWN and no cause is asserted
external_evidence.reason: Microsoft-Windows-TaskScheduler/Operational is disabled on this host and no event file exists for it, so the channel has never recorded a single run of this task; the enabled Microsoft-Windows-TaskScheduler/Maintenance channel holds only its own maintenance events, which name no task; and the Security channel, which would carry a process-creation record if that audit subcategory were enabled and if this session could read it, is not readable here

invocation_provenance.last_manual_error: rounds=0, spacing=5.0, depth-limit=100: a window must declare a positive cadence
invocation_provenance.reading: a manual or verification invocation is not the schedule: it neither raises the status of the observation programme nor refreshes its heartbeat

missed_window_attendance.conflict_reading: the tick's log and the scheduler's own reporting disagreed about the slot; the record says so instead of choosing a side
missed_window_attendance.reading: the cause of every missed window was re-derived from the run events, from the declared grid and from the external record of the scheduler, never taken from the record on trust
missed_window_attendance.unattended_reading: a slot nobody attended is a failure of the host or of the task — and it is only claimed when the external record covers every instant of the slot and the scheduler's own reporting named no run inside it
missed_window_attendance.unknown_reading: a slot is recorded as unknown when the tick's own log holds no event for it and the external record cannot cover it: an absent line in a program's own diary is not proof that nothing ran

raw_evidence.reading: every window's uncompressed bytes were re-hashed before it was counted

reading: a tick that ran and skipped the exchange observed nothing: health is about the schedule and about the evidence on disk, and no heartbeat is ever counted as a sample
reasons: every declared slot so far is either observed or recorded as missed, the raw evidence reproduces, the task is installed and enabled, and storage is healthy
